title: The explicit geometric cohomology equivalence intertwines conjugate Frobenius
statement:
In the setting of [def-pod-cohomology-geometric-equivalence], let $r\ge0$ be an
integer and suppose the geometric Galois Frobenius automorphisms of the two geometric
fibers satisfy $e\circ\tau_Y=\tau_X^r\circ e$ as scheme morphisms. Write $F_X,F_Y$ for
the constant-Weil-sheaf cohomological Frobenius operators of
[def-weil-global-geometric-frobenius]. Then the explicitly constructed linear
equivalence $e_i$ of [def-pod-cohomology-geometric-equivalence] satisfies
$e_i(F_Yx)=F_X^r(e_i(x))$ for every integer $i$ and every
$x\in H^i(\overline Y,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$. No field extension or relation between
the finite base fields is assumed beyond the given geometric conjugacy.

source.place: Proof, item (6), passage from geometric Frobenius conjugacy on the common geometric fiber to the cohomological operator F^r

proof.text: Use the existing upstream theorem with exactly the recorded signature. Its carrier comparison cohomologyCarrierIso and Frobenius compatibility identify the specified equivalence with homology of derivedGlobalSectionsUnitIso, as in [def-pod-cohomology-geometric-equivalence].

Invert the conjugacy equation to get tau_Y inverse followed by e equal to e followed by tau_X to the power r inverse. Apply derivedGlobalSectionsUnitIso_trans and the homology functor. The two sides become equal composites on derived-global-section homology.

The proved upstream helper cohomologyCarrierIso_inv_derivedGlobalSectionsUnitIso_pow identifies transport along the inverse r-th power with the r-th power of cohomological Frobenius, by induction including r=0. Conjugate the identity of the preceding step by the carrier comparisons. This is the existing complete upstream proof, with no new obligation.

theorem cohomologyLinearEquivOfGeometricFiberIso_map_frobenius
    (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] [Field k'] [Finite k']
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)] [Fact (ringChar k' ≠ l)]
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k'))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k'))] [QuasiSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k'))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k'))]
    (r : ℕ) (e : (Y ↘ Spec (.of k')).geometricFiber ≅ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).geometricFiber)
    (he : (Y ↘ Spec (.of k')).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom ≫ e.hom =
      e.hom ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ r).hom) (i : ℤ)
    (x : ((adicConstant k' l Y).cohomology i).carrier) :
    cohomologyLinearEquivOfGeometricFiberIso k k' l X Y e i
        (((adicConstant k' l Y).cohomology i).frobenius x) =
      (((adicConstant k l X).cohomology i).frobeniusEnd ^ r)
        (cohomologyLinearEquivOfGeometricFiberIso k k' l X Y e i x)
